Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the conversation with Ben last week — TideWave is moving quickly on a small PoC and we want to make sure exec stakeholders see the value early. Our CIO Adam Li would like a short exec-level intro/demo that highlights latency/cost tradeoffs and how Redwood would fit into our data residency constraints.

High level ask:
- 30–45 minute exec intro (VP/CIO) + 30 minute technical breakouts immediately after
- A few example prompts and expected latency numbers would be very helpful

Adam is traveling this week but said he could try for a morning slot next day (Pacific). Are you able to propose 2 windows tomorrow or the day after? If Marissa or a senior product leader at Redwood can join for the first 30 minutes, that would be ideal.

I attached a short list of TideWave priorities; happy to adjust.

TideWave Systems
